# CI subset of the game-asset corpus

Every file here is CC0 1.0 (public domain dedication) and is a byte-identical copy of the corpus file named in `index.json` (SHA-256 checked by `tests/game-corpus.test.mjs`). Kenney's own licence text is in `kenney-License.txt`; the OpenGameArt pages state CC0 in their licence field. The full corpus, including files that must never be committed, is described in `docs/GAME-CORPUS.md`.
